home.heroTitle: Software built by people who maintain it too.
home.heroSubtitle: Sof2eze partners with teams to design, build, and ship products that hold up long after launch day.

about.history: Sof2eze started in 2021 as a two-person freelance partnership and grew into a full studio without losing the habit of treating every project like our own product.
about.mission: Build software that the people who inherit it later are glad to work in.
about.vision: To be the team clients call back for the next project, not just the first one.
